And now that they've been open for probably 2 years they have a very low rating on Google.. food takes 2 hours to come out of the kitchen. They've had a pretty much change their menu to one burger and fries. This is so unfortunate because they have a massive and amazing kitchen in that restaurant. This place has so much potential for some chef that is actually passionate about food but could never afford something like this. America and the American dream is an absolute joke.

comments.text: There's a really fancy restaurant in Detroit called "Prime & Proper" yeah stupid name right? My point is that its very very good. The kind of place you take a date to when you really think they care about luxury and materialistic nonsense. This place has barely raised their prices.. compared to most other restaurants. It's maybe ten percent more expensive than it was 3 years ago. They're constantly packed even selling 80-500 dollar steaks.. all these other restaurants don't have an excuse for raising prices like 50 percent.
